_note: Worlds that the research corpus does not list but that the lore events need. Each is a short record in the corpus's own shape. Positions are best guesses placed from how the novels and codexes describe them (`anchor`), or inside a recorded sector. None of these has published coordinates.

worlds.name: Isstvan III
worlds.affiliation: Imperial compliance world; virus-bombed by the Warmaster in M31
worlds.notable: Where Horus purged the loyalists inside his own Traitor Legions, the opening atrocity of the Horus Heresy.
anchor: Placed by guess: the novels put the Isstvan system on the far side of Ultima from Terra but give no map position.

era_status.pre_rift: A dead, virus-scoured world since the opening of the Horus Heresy.

worlds.name: Isstvan V
worlds.notable: Site of the Drop Site Massacre, where three loyal Legions were betrayed and broken.

era_status.pre_rift: An airless graveyard of the Drop Site Massacre.
era_status.post_rift: Unchanged; a shrine of loss to the Iron Hands, Salamanders and Raven Guard.

worlds.name: Davin
worlds.affiliation: Imperial compliance world; fell to Chaos in M31
worlds.notable: Horus was struck down on Davin's moon and healed in the Delphos temple here, where his fall began.
anchor: Placed by guess near the Isstvan region; no published map position.

era_status.pre_rift: Long lost to Chaos; its warrior lodges were the root of the Warrior Lodges in the Legions.

worlds.name: Molech
worlds.affiliation: Imperium (Knight houses); overrun by the Warmaster's forces in M31
worlds.notable: A Knight world bound up with the Emperor's own past, which Horus conquered to seize the secret it hid.
anchor: Placed by guess between the Eye of Terror and Segmentum Solar, along Horus's line of advance to Terra.

era_status.pre_rift: Lost to the Imperium since the Heresy.

worlds.name: Beta-Garmon II
worlds.notable: The heart of the Beta-Garmon cluster, where the largest Titan battle in history was fought on the road to Terra.
anchor: Placed by guess on the approaches to Segmentum Solar; Beta-Garmon is described as the gateway to the Segmentum Solar.

era_status.pre_rift: Rebuilt or abandoned after the Heresy; status uncertain.

worlds.name: Signus Prime
worlds.affiliation: Imperial compliance world; overrun by daemons in M31
worlds.notable: Where Sanguinius and the Blood Angels were lured into a daemon-haunted trap at the start of the Heresy.
anchor: Placed by guess in northern Ultima; the Signus Cluster has no published map position.

era_status.pre_rift: A haunted world; its fate after the Heresy is not recorded.

worlds.name: Nikaea
worlds.notable: Host of the Council of Nikaea, where the Emperor ruled on the use of psychic powers.
anchor: Placed by guess; Nikaea's position is not published.

worlds.name: Sixty-Three Nineteen
worlds.notable: A lost human empire claiming to be the true Imperium; Horus's first campaign as Warmaster.
anchor: Placed by guess in the north-western rim; no published map position.

era_status.pre_rift: Brought into compliance in the Great Crusade.

worlds.name: Murder
worlds.notable: A Megarachnid death world so lethal that its first Imperial visitors named it Murder.
anchor: Placed by guess in the western rim; no published map position.

era_status.pre_rift: The Megarachnid were exterminated by the Luna Wolves and Blood Angels.

worlds.name: Khur
worlds.affiliation: Imperial compliance world; razed by the Ultramarines in M31
worlds.notable: Its city of Monarchia was a perfect cathedral to the Emperor, levelled on the Emperor's own order.
anchor: Placed by guess close to Colchis; Khur was a Word Bearers compliance.

era_status.pre_rift: A ruin since the Great Crusade.

worlds.name: Armatura
worlds.affiliation: Imperium (Ultramar); attacked by the World Eaters and Word Bearers in M31
worlds.notable: The great war-college of the Five Hundred Worlds, assaulted during the Shadow Crusade.

era_status.pre_rift: Rebuilt; a training world of Ultramar.

worlds.name: Ullanor Prime
worlds.affiliation: Imperium (former Ork empire of Urlakk Urg)
worlds.notable: The throne world of the greatest Ork empire of the Great Crusade, and the site of the Ullanor Triumph.

era_status.pre_rift: An Imperial world; the plain of the Triumph remains.

worlds.name: Menazoid Epsilon
worlds.affiliation: Chaos-held; liberated in the Sabbat Worlds Crusade
worlds.notable: Hiding place of a Standard Template Construct, the prize at the heart of First and Only.

worlds.name: Hagia
worlds.notable: Holy world of Saint Sabbat, from which her relics were carried away under fire.

worlds.name: Phantine
worlds.notable: A world of poisonous clouds where only the hive spires rise above the cloud deck; liberated in the air war of The Guns of Tanith.

worlds.name: Aexe Cardinal
worlds.notable: Trench-war world of the Aexe Alliance against the Shadik Republic.

worlds.name: Herodor
worlds.notable: Where a girl believed to be Saint Sabbat reborn rallied the defence against Chaos.

worlds.name: Gereon
worlds.notable: An occupied world where Gaunt's team was sent to kill a traitor general.

worlds.name: Ancreon Sextus
worlds.notable: World of the great ziggurat-hives, the target of His Last Command.

worlds.name: Jago
worlds.notable: A windswept rock where the Ghosts held the haunted fortress of Hinzerhaus.

worlds.name: Hubris
worlds.notable: Frozen world in its slow winter, where Eisenhorn hunted Murdin Eyclone.

worlds.name: Gudrun
worlds.notable: A cultured world of the Helican subsector, home to Eisenhorn's estates.

worlds.name: Thracian Primaris
worlds.notable: Site of the Great Triumph massacre, a psychic atrocity at a victory celebration.

worlds.name: Eustis Majoris
worlds.notable: Sector capital of the Angelus subsector; its hive Petropolis is Ravenor's hunting ground.

worlds.name: Sancour
worlds.notable: World of the city of Queen Mab, where Alizebeth Bequin begins to learn what she is.

worlds.name: Gravalax
worlds.affiliation: Imperium; courted by the T'au Empire
worlds.notable: A frontier world where Ciaphas Cain uncovered a genestealer plot behind a T'au crisis.
anchor: Placed by guess on the Damocles Gulf frontier, as the novel puts it close to T'au space.

worlds.name: Perlia
worlds.notable: An Ork-ravaged world Cain had to cross with a band of stragglers.
anchor: Placed by guess; no published position.

worlds.name: Tarsis Ultra
worlds.notable: A frozen world near Ultramar that stood against a Tyranid hive fleet beside the Ultramarines.
anchor: Placed by guess on the Eastern Fringe near Ultramar.

worlds.name: Salinas
worlds.notable: The first world Uriel Ventris and Pasanius reached after escaping the Eye of Terror, with dark secrets of its own.
anchor: Placed by guess in eastern Ultima.

worlds.name: Tyran
worlds.notable: An outpost world whose dying signal gave Ultramar its first warning of Hive Fleet Behemoth.
anchor: Placed on the eastern edge of Ultramar, the direction Behemoth came from.

worlds.name: Ichar IV
worlds.notable: Hive world saved from Hive Fleet Kraken by a coalition of Space Marine Chapters.
anchor: Placed in the path of Hive Fleet Kraken on the Eastern Fringe.
